verdict.rationale: Mailchimp is a SaaS whose Marketing and Transactional APIs let scripts do core work without the UI. Documented endpoints cover creating contacts, sending campaigns, sending SMS, managing routes and generating account exports, and webhooks push events back to automation, though webhooks need the Standard or Premium plan. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling and docs (auth tokens for pipelines, SDK/CI examples), and independent or hands-on evidence of headless/CI usage.
